status: editorial backlog, not applied; source pages identified, final prose and image rights require checking
rules: One main subject per annual day. Expanding an existing subject does not create another scheduled article.
Counts exclude connections and interludes; current_cards includes intro plus explicit chapters.
Use at least seven different horizontal images for an intro and six chapters. No cover in a narrative card unless its design is the actual subject.
Each chapter names its own subject in the kicker and explains its relation to the featured game.
Source links are primary evidence or primary-source research entry points. Do not treat an unverified release day as a fact.
